description: A production company needs to transport their equipment and staff for a movie they are shooting using large mobile production units or small mobile production units. Large mobile production units can hold 6 people and takes up 2 parking spots whereas small mobile production units can hold only 2 people and takes up 1 parking spot. Movie stars prefer to have their small mobile production unit to share with a close staff, therefore at least 5 units must be small mobile units. However, due to logistic limitations, large mobile production units are more space efficient per spot, they must make up at least 75% of all vehicles. If the movie needs to transport 80 people, minimize the total number of parking spots required by this production.

CapacityLargeUnit.definition: Number of people that one large mobile production unit can hold

ParkingLargeUnit.definition: Number of parking spots occupied by one large mobile production unit

CapacitySmallUnit.definition: Number of people that one small mobile production unit can hold

ParkingSmallUnit.definition: Number of parking spots occupied by one small mobile production unit

MinSmallUnits.definition: Minimum number of small mobile production units required

MinLargeUnitProportion.definition: Minimum proportion of large mobile production units relative to total vehicles

TotalPeople.definition: Total number of people that need to be transported

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of parking spots required to transport all 80 people using large and small mobile production units"

LargeUnits.definition: Number of large mobile production units used

SmallUnits.definition: Number of small mobile production units used
